The '''Hatch Breaker Limpet Controller''' launches limpets that attach to a targeted ship's cargo hatch and force it open, spilling some of that ship's cargo for the attacker to collect.

== Overview ==

Hatch Breaker limpets are one of four original Limpet Controller types (alongside [[Collector Limpet Controller|Collector]], [[Fuel Transfer Limpet Controller|Fuel Transfer]], and [[Prospector Limpet Controller|Prospector]]), and are the module that actually makes ship-to-ship piracy possible — without one, a pirate can disable a target's drive but has no way to make it release cargo. A target with a functioning [[Electronic Countermeasure]] can strip an attached Hatch Breaker limpet before it finishes forcing the hatch, so piracy builds and their defences are closely linked.

{{Important|Piracy carries legal and reputation consequences within the game's factions and Powerplay systems. This article describes what the module does, not whether using it is advisable in a given situation.}}
